fieldValues.title: RFC-009 Change C: Add description and vocabulary-backed tags on Container
fieldValues.proposed_change: Container gains normative description?: string (boundary label). Container tags?: string[] aligns with RFC-006 vocabulary substrate: when a Vocabulary declares Terms for a tag key, tags MUST resolve against those Terms (I-65). Free-string tags valid when no Vocabulary governs the key. Containers continue to carry no typed fieldValues and do not participate in the Relation graph (Invariant 20 unchanged).
fieldValues.rationale: description was already in the Rust implementation but not formally specified. tags follow the RFC-006 emergent vocabulary pattern: free strings are valid baseline; Vocabulary overlays curation.
